purpose: Machine-readable BTC orderflow knowledge for Bossman Trader Apprentice. Analysis only; no autonomous execution.
data_integrity_rules: Never invent missing CVD, OI or liquidation values.
Do not reuse stale CVD/OI values as if they are current.
Compare CVD/OI deltas only when source, instrument and aggregation/settings are compatible.
Do not compare CoinGlass aggregate OI directly with Coinwise/K1m6a OI as if they are the same series.
Tag CME/reference chart levels separately from spot/perpetual execution-market prices.
A single wick/touch is not acceptance; require multiple observations or retest evidence.
Endpoint deltas can miss failed-breakout paths; preserve observed high/low and liquidation context when visible.

metric_semantics.price: Outcome variable: whether aggressive flow is actually moving the market.
metric_semantics.cvd: Aggressive buy minus sell flow proxy. Direction alone is insufficient; compare with price response.
metric_semantics.open_interest: Total open derivative contracts. Rising means more open leverage/contracts; falling means net closure/liquidation. It does not directly identify longs versus shorts.
metric_semantics.liquidations: Forced closure signal. Useful for diagnosing flushes but not a standalone reversal signal.
metric_semantics.high_low_path: Observed excursion inside the analysis window. Needed for detecting breakout failures that endpoint-only deltas can hide.

regime_matrix.interpretation: Sell aggression plus falling OI: position closure/deleveraging dominates.
notes: Less bearish than a falling market with OI expansion.
Do not short the liquidation low automatically.
Wait for absorption, stabilization or reclaim before considering a long.

regime_matrix.interpretation: New leverage is expanding while price and aggressive flow move lower.
notes: Materially worse for a long thesis than simple deleveraging.
Do not claim new shorts with certainty from OI alone; call it bearish leverage-expansion/short-build risk.
Require a new reclaim/absorption setup before considering another long.

regime_matrix.interpretation: Aggressive buy flow improves but price still falls while OI contracts: buying is being absorbed by passive selling while leverage exits.
notes: Less dangerous than bearish leverage expansion because OI is contracting rather than expanding.
Not bullish confirmation: positive CVD that cannot lift price is buyer inefficiency.
Require price reclaim/acceptance before treating CVD improvement as a long signal.

regime_matrix.interpretation: Price, aggressive demand and open participation expand together.
notes: Avoid chasing if OI spikes vertically after an already extended move.

regime_matrix.interpretation: Price rises while CVD falls and OI expands: aggressive selling is being absorbed while new leverage enters.
notes: Potentially strong bullish divergence/absorption because sellers are aggressive but price still rises.
OI expansion can become squeeze fuel, but OI alone does not prove the new leverage is short.
Do not chase directly into dVAH/zone resistance; prefer acceptance above resistance or a successful retest of reclaimed value.

regime_matrix.interpretation: Price and aggressive buying recover while leverage is still being cleaned/closed.
Price rises without CVD confirmation while OI falls.
notes: Can be a relief bounce/short covering move.
Do not chase resistance without reclaim and renewed demand.

regime_matrix.interpretation: Aggressive sellers fail to make lower price; possible passive buyer/absorption.
Aggressive buying fails to lift price; possible hidden seller.

path_overlays.name: FAILED_BREAKOUT_LONG_FLUSH
conditions: Observed window high trades above dVAH/upper value resistance.
Latest reference-chart price rejects back below dPOC.
Open interest contracts materially versus the previous compatible observation.
CVD is flat or down rather than positively confirming the breakout.
Long liquidations materially dominate short liquidations.
path_overlays.interpretation: A leverage-driven breakout attempt failed and late longs were flushed. Endpoint-only Price/CVD/OI deltas can miss this path because the window may finish near where it started.
path_overlays.restore_long_candidate: Reclaim dPOC first, then dVAH/upper value, and prove acceptance/retest with non-deteriorating flow.

level_definitions.dVAL: Daily value area low; lower boundary of accepted daily value.
level_definitions.dPOC: Daily point of control; most accepted/highest-volume daily price area.
level_definitions.dVAH: Daily value area high; upper boundary of accepted daily value.
level_definitions.pDayLow: Prior/current session day low as labelled by source.
level_definitions.pDayHigh: Prior/current session day high as labelled by source.

level_state_machine.touch: Price reaches or wicks through level; not sufficient confirmation.
level_state_machine.reclaim: Previous valid observation below level, current observation above level.
level_state_machine.acceptance: Multiple observations remain above/below level or a successful retest confirms the side.
level_state_machine.sweep_and_reclaim: Recent trade below a known level followed by a return above it; strongest when flow stops deteriorating.

confirmed_reclaim: CVD stable or rising, OR price demonstrates strong absorption despite falling CVD.
OI behavior not deteriorating into price-down/CVD-down/OI-up.
sweep_absorption: Price stops making lower lows or immediately reclaims.
CVD can remain weak only if selling fails to push price lower.
OI must not expand aggressively during continuing downside.
forbidden_add_conditions: Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI UP persists.
Price DOWN + CVD UP + OI DOWN is not a long signal unless price itself reclaims/accepts the structural level.
FAILED_BREAKOUT_LONG_FLUSH is active until dPOC and then dVAH are reclaimed/accepted.
Live values are stale, hidden or from incompatible sources.
Only one isolated screenshot exists and there is no sequence context.

notes: Do not assume equal tranche size unless actually equal.
Raw return is unlevered and before fees/funding.
After partial exits track remaining quantity, realized PnL and unrealized PnL separately.

historical_case_2026_09.outcome: Closed around breakeven before later bearish leverage-expansion phase.
lessons: Initial Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI DOWN behaved as deleveraging and allowed several recoveries.
Price recovery while OI stayed depressed was constructive but often looked like short covering/absorption rather than strong new trend demand.
Repeated 79.9-80.1k touches did not equal acceptance.
Later Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI UP plus loss of 78.8k represented a regime change; old long thesis should not be defended.

historical_case_77k.context: BTC around 77.9k after impulse from about 76.75k.
historical_case_77k.bull_pattern: Price held 77.55-77.8 despite weak/flattening CVD with elevated OI; interpreted as possible absorption/hidden buyer and squeeze setup.
historical_case_77k.bear_failure: Acceptance below 77.55 then loss of 77.27, especially with falling CVD and rising OI.

learned_patterns_2026_09_09.state: Price DOWN + CVD UP + OI DOWN
learned_patterns_2026_09_09.name: BUYER_FAILURE_WITH_DELEVERAGING
learned_patterns_2026_09_09.interpretation: CVD improvement failed to produce higher price while OI contracted. This points to passive seller absorption/buyer inefficiency during deleveraging rather than fresh bearish leverage expansion.
learned_patterns_2026_09_09.long_rule: Do not treat CVD improvement alone as bullish; require dVAL hold plus dPOC/upper-value reclaim and acceptance.

learned_patterns_2026_09_09.state: Price UP + CVD DOWN + OI UP
learned_patterns_2026_09_09.name: LEVERAGED_SELL_ABSORPTION
learned_patterns_2026_09_09.interpretation: Price advanced strongly despite large aggressive net selling while OI increased. Seller aggression is being absorbed as leverage grows; this can become squeeze fuel, but side attribution is not proven by OI.
learned_patterns_2026_09_09.long_rule: Treat as a long candidate only after structural confirmation. Prefer acceptance above dVAH/upper zone or a clean retest of reclaimed dPOC/dOpen rather than chasing resistance.

learned_patterns_2026_09_09.state: intrawindow breakout above dVAH -> rejection below dPOC + CVD flat + OI DOWN + long liquidations dominant
learned_patterns_2026_09_09.name: FAILED_BREAKOUT_LONG_FLUSH
learned_patterns_2026_09_09.interpretation: Upper-value breakout failed and late longs were flushed as leverage contracted. This invalidates the prior long-candidate state until value is reclaimed again.
learned_patterns_2026_09_09.long_rule: No chase/add. Reclaim dPOC first, then dVAH, then require acceptance/retest.
